title: hYYa Footprint Inspector
shortDescription: Bona okwaziwa izinhlelo zakho, ukulungise masinyane. Kumahhala, kuyimfihlo.
fullDescription:
Izinhlelo zakho zokusebenza zingazi okuningi ngawe kunalokho ocabangayo. I-hYYa Footprint Inspector ikukhombisa lokho ezikubonayo, ukuthi ubani ongakubuka, nokuthi ungakulungisa kanjani, ngamagama alula.

IZINYATHELO EZINE EZILULA
1. Umkhondo wedijithali: ngokuthepha kanye, hlola lokho noma yiluphi uhlelo olungakufunda ngomkhondo wedivayisi yakho.
2. Izinhlelo ezibucayi: bona ukuthi yiziphi izinhlelo zakho abanye abangazibona, njengezinhlelo zokuthandana, ezokholo, ezempilo noma ze-VPN, nokuthi lokho kungathini ngawe.
3. Izilandeleli: bona ukuthi yiziphi izinhlelo ezingafunda isikrini sakho, zifunde zonke izaziso, noma zikhiye idivayisi yakho. Izinhlelo ezinezimvume ezingaphezu kweyodwa kulezi ziyamakwa, ngoba izinhlelo zokugada zisebenza kanjalo. Bese uvula irekhodi le-Android uqobo lokuthi yiziphi izinhlelo ezisebenzise indawo yakho, ikhamera kanye nombhobho.
4. Ukuhlola ubumfihlo: landela izinyathelo ezilula ezifana nezibuyekezo, ukuqala kabusha idivayisi masonto onke kanye nokuhlola amaphasiwedi avunyelwe, bese ubheka izilungiselelo zakho ngazinye futhi ubuyise izimvume zezinhlelo zokusebenza ongafuni ukuzinikeza.

ISIKOLO ESISODWA SAKHO KONKE OKUNE
Isikolo sakho sobumfihlo, kokungama-100, sihlanganisa konke ukuhlola okune. Uma siphezulu kungcono kakhulu, futhi siyakhula njengoba uqeda ukuhlola ngakunye. Faka i-widget ukuze ubone isikolo sakho kanye nokuhlola kwakho kokugcina ngokubheka nje.

LUNGISA NAMI
Thepha u-"Zilungise nami" bese uhlelo lukuhola esinyathelweni ngasinye sokulungisa, lunye ngesikhathi, likuvulele izilungiselelo eziqondile. Bese uhlola futhi ubone isikolo sakho sikhuphuka.

KUCACILE, KUNOKUTHULA KANYE NOKWETHEMBEKA
• Ishadi lemibala ekhasini ngalinye: okubomvu kudinga ukubhekwa, okuphuzi kufanele ukwazi, okuluhlaza kulungile.
• Konke okutholakele ngamagama alula: isihloko esifushane, umugqa owodwa wokuthi kungani kubalulekile, nokuthi kukulungiswa kanjani.
• Izinhlelo ezakhelwe ngaphakathi kudivayisi yakho azimakwa, kanti izinhlelo zokulawula kwabazali noma zomsebenzi zibizwa ngalokho eziyikho ngempela.
• Ukwethembeka okuthi "ngu-Google kuphela noma umenzi wedivayisi ongakulungisa lokhu" lapho kungekho ongakwenza.
• Isikhumbuzi samasonto onke noma senyanga sokuhlola futhi, uma usithanda.

UKWAZIWA NOMA USUYISUSILE INHLELO
I-Android inikeza izinhlelo zenkampani ngayinye ikhodi ehlala injalo ngisho ungayisusa bese uyifaka kabusha. Bona eyakho, nokuthi kungani ukusetha kabusha kwasefekthri kuphela okuyishintshayo.

KUKLANYELWE UBUMFIHLO
• Ayikho imvume ye-inthanethi: uhlelo alukwazi ukuxhuma noma kuphi, ngakho-ke akukho okuphuma kudivayisi yakho.
• Ayikho i-akhawunti, azikho izikhangiso, akukho ukulandelela.
• Kumahhala. Akukho okuthengwayo, akukho ukubhalisa.
• Umthombo ovulekile, ngakho noma ubani angahlola ukuthi lusebenza kanjani.

Hlangana nomsentshisi: usesikrinini ngasinye futhi unamathiphu uma umthepha.

I-hYYa Footprint Inspector iyingxenye yomndeni wakwa-hYYa wezinhlelo zokusebenza ezibeka ubumfihlo phambili.
releaseNotes:
• Bona isikolo sakho sobumfihlo ngokushesha nge-widget entsha.
Lokhu kukhishwa kuqukethe ukulungiswa kweziphazamisi okuvamile kanye nokuthuthukiswa kokusimama.
